name: web-components
description: Pulumi component library for AWS web hosting environments

domainName.description: The domain name for which the certificate should be issued

zoneId.description: The Route53 hosted zone ID where the validation record will be created

certificateArn.description: The ARN of the validated certificate

vpcId.description: The VPC ID where resources will be created

vpcCidr.description: The CIDR block of the VPC for security group rules

imageId.description: The AMI ID to use for EC2 instances

instanceCount.description: The number of instances to run (optional)

publicSubnetIds.description: List of public subnet IDs for the load balancer and instances

certificateArn.description: The ARN of the ACM certificate for HTTPS

zoneId.description: The Route53 hosted zone ID for DNS alias (optional)

subdomain.description: The subdomain for the DNS alias record (optional)
